description: Pinned identity of the Atlanta Fed Policy Rules Database oracle path. The adapter drives the PRD R package through the local policyengine-prd emulator (PolicyEngine/prd-comparison), whose Household schema is projected from thin Axiom cases and whose PRDRunner shells out to Rscript. Neither piece is vendored here; this file pins what an oracle number produced against PRD was computed with.

emulator.note: Installed editable from a local checkout (~/policyengine-prd); not on PyPI. The runner imports policyengine_prd.PRDRunner.

r_package.upstream: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Policy Rules Database (policy-rules-database 2.0.0 source tree)
r_package.requires: R >= 4.0 with the PRD package installed; the adapter invokes Rscript.

rule_years.note: Verified empirically: ruleYear 2026 returns the 2025 parameter vintage unchanged (e.g. CO SNAP household-of-2 value.snap 6432 = 12 x $536 FY2025 maximum at both 2025 and 2026), so 2026-period comparisons read PRD as its latest 2025 vintage and disposition the FY-vintage residuals.

output_conventions.period: Annual sums per ruleYear; the adapter normalizes month-defined benefit columns (value.snap, value.tanf, value.ssi, ...) to one month when the comparison period is a month.
output_conventions.identity: hhid preserved through create_synthetic_families and generate_expenses_benefits.
